dead_or_avoid.name: Freenom
dead_or_avoid.note: Free tier ended. Registrations paused March 2023 (Meta lawsuit), ICANN accreditation terminated, exited free domains Feb 2024; ~12.6M free domains stopped resolving. Now paid (~$10/yr for .tk/.cf/.gq).

dead_or_avoid.name: us.kg / xx.kg (DigitalPlat)
dead_or_avoid.note: New registrations paused after abuse problems. Use dpdns.org instead.
